root_causes.title: generated file catalog is stale
root_causes.defect: internal/preflight/preflight_codes_test.go was tracked but absent from the checked-in FILE_CATALOG; the generator enumerated only the caller's cwd via bare `git ls-files` and depended on accidental developer staging state, so a new file committed without a final regeneration drifted CI
fix: generator: resolve repo root via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` and anchor enumeration + both output files to it (cwd-independent)
generator: enumerate `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z` (staging-independent universe; .gitignore still filters caches/build products)
generator: skip the catalog's own two files (matches the coverage contract's catalogPolicyExclusions)
coverage test: same enumeration universe so the two sides can never disagree on a clean hosted checkout (byte-identical to plain git ls-files there)
CI: new audit-lane freshness gate — regenerate and `git diff --exit-code` the two artifacts; regeneration must be a byte-level no-op
regression_evidence: baseline reproduction: test FAILED at 79b21a4 with exactly [internal/preflight/preflight_codes_test.go] missing
after fix: internal/releasecontract suite green on linux/amd64 go1.27.4
determinism: two consecutive `go run ./scripts/gen-filecatalog` runs byte-identical (cmp)

root_causes.title: installer-retirement scanner self-matching false positives
root_causes.defect: the scanner walked the filesystem and matched forward-slash guard prefixes (internal/releasecontract/, cmd/stress_release_surface.go) against the RAW filepath.Rel result; on Windows filepath.Rel yields backslash separators, so the guard never exempted itself and flagged cmd/stress_release_surface.go, internal/releasecontract/installer_contract_test.go and internal/releasecontract/packagegate_contract_test.go — the very files that must NAME makensis to keep it forbidden
fix: enumeration switched to `git ls-files -z` from the repo root (tracked files only; git emits forward slashes on every OS — platform separators can no longer defeat the guard)

exemption classification extracted into isInstallerScanExempt with unconditional backslash-to-slash normalization (strings.ReplaceAll, NOT filepath.ToSlash which is a no-op for backslashes on non-Windows hosts)
scan targets extracted into installerScanTargets; offense semantics unchanged (makensis literal or .nsi script)
security intent preserved: no installer restored, negative regression tests kept and strengthened
regression_evidence: TestInstallerScanExemptPathsSurviveWindowsSeparators pins backslash-shaped guard/history paths classify as exempt on every OS
TestInstallerScanEnumeratesTrackedFilesWithForwardSlashes pins the enumeration emits no backslash paths on the real repo
guard-literal load-bearing check: the three guard sources still contain makensis and are still exempt
full tracked-tree scan green on linux/amd64 (the Windows-hosted re-run remains a hosted gate)

root_causes.title: Linux build-version gate parses user-facing output
root_causes.failing_test: workflow step 'Cross-check the compiled binary's version' (build-desktop.yml Linux x64 lane)
root_causes.exact_location: .github/workflows/build-desktop.yml (grep -m1 -oE 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' on `$bin version` compared to APP_VERSION=1.11.1); cmd/root.go earlyVersionDispatch
root_causes.defect: the gate grepped the HUMAN `version` banner for a numeric semver; the ALPHA identity change made `version` print brand.Stage (correctly), the grep returned <none> and the gate went red — a workflow-contract bug, not a build failure
fix: new read-only machine-readable identity probe: `SHEYTAN-LA build-info` handled by earlyVersionDispatch (zero filesystem side effects, same contract as `version`), emitting one compact JSON line with fixed field order: app, product_stage, build_id, go, os, arch
product_stage = internal/brand.Stage (public ALPHA identity); build_id = internal/config.AppVersion (internal numeric build identifier) — asserted INDEPENDENTLY by the workflow
human `version` output unchanged (ALPHA branding, never leaks the numeric identifier — existing purity suite untouched)
Linux workflow cross-check step rewritten to the build-info JSON contract with independent field assertions and the preserved isolated-probe residue check
printversion (--plain/--json) and APP_VERSION=1.11.1 chain untouched (internal reproducibility/packaging metadata)
regression_evidence: baseline reproduction at 79b21a4: headless binary `version` prints ALPHA identity; the retired grep returns <none> (rc=1) — matches the consolidated log exactly
after fix: `build-info` emits the JSON; the workflow's exact sed extraction + independent assertions pass; probe dir left empty
cmd unit tests green: TestBuildInfoDispatchIsReadOnlyAndExact (exact field set, field-by-field authority checks, read-only probe) and TestBuildInfoIsHandledByTheEarlyDispatch
